items.title: Death Note TV Drama-Episode 1
items.description: First episode of the Japanese Death Note TV drama! I noticed episodes 2-11 were up, but not the first one, so here it is. This TV drama is a great live-action adaptation of the anime and very faithful to the source material. It's one you can watch again and again. Enjoy!
